title: Gemini 3.0 Pro Surpasses Radiology Trainees on RadLE — What It Means
excerpt: The latest RadLE benchmark results show frontier multimodal AI crossing trainee-level performance, while still falling well short of experts.

children.text: Gemini 3.0 Pro outperformed radiology trainees on RadLE, a result that matters because it turns benchmark progress into a clinically legible threshold.
Why the expert gap still matters
The same results also show a clear deployment boundary: expert radiologists remain substantially ahead, leaving a 26-point margin that cannot be waved away as noise.

seoTitle: Gemini 3.0 Pro Surpasses Radiology Trainees on RadLE
seoDescription: What the latest RadLE results say about the real progress and real limits of frontier healthcare AI.

title: Why We Built Radiology's Last Exam: The Gap Nobody Was Measuring
excerpt: CRASH Lab started from a simple observation: most clinical AI systems were being evaluated against the wrong baseline.

children.text: If a model claims clinical usefulness, it should be measured against the clinicians it intends to assist or replace. That standard was missing.

seoTitle: Why CRASH Lab Built Radiology's Last Exam
seoDescription: The origin story behind RadLE and the measurement gap it was designed to fix.

title: 6 Abstracts at RSNA 2025: What CRASH Lab Presented in Chicago
excerpt: From benchmark design to report generation, CRASH Lab used RSNA 2025 to show the shape of its research agenda.

children.text: Six accepted abstracts at RSNA 2025 gave the lab a public record of its pace and research range across evaluation, workflow design, and data infrastructure.
